scenario: IoT 设备异常流量告警实为固件更新（误报）

judgment.summary: Outbound traffic identified as legitimate scheduled firmware update based on threat intelligence and related alert correlation.
evidence_chain: Alert detail indicates 500MB outbound data from 10.0.8.200 to cdn-update.com at 03:10 (query_alert_detail)
Threat intelligence confirms cdn-update.com is a legitimate CDN provider for IoT firmware, not malicious (query_threat_intel)
Related alert A19-REL-01 shows scheduled firmware update check initiated at 03:00, correlating with traffic timing (query_related_alerts)
Asset info confirms device is a surveillance camera in IoT zone, consistent with firmware update behavior (query_asset_info)

iocs.context: Legitimate CDN provider for IoT firmware updates

remediation: Close alert A19 as false positive due to confirmed legitimate firmware update activity.
Verify with asset owner (facility@company.com) that the update schedule aligns with current maintenance windows.
Update baseline thresholds for this camera to prevent recurrence of similar volume-based alerts during scheduled updates.
